summary: Accendra Health filed an 8-K regarding a Commitment Letter to refinance debt. The company will offer $326.25M of 9.000% Senior Secured First Lien Notes due 2032, with a $261M backstop purchase at par by certain noteholders and lenders. A 3.50% cash fee is payable to backstop parties. The transaction includes exchange offers and consent solicitations for its existing 4.500% senior notes due 2029 and 6.625% senior notes due 2030 (83% held by consenting parties). The restructuring reduces leverage and extends maturities. Watch for exchange offer uptake and consent thresholds; risk-arb centers on successful completion and noteholder participation.
